selectionReason: PCX-053 through PCX-057 were rechecked against current ProjectDump wiki source and current project-owned evidence. PCX-053 Bounty, PCX-054 Source Finder, PCX-055 Script Polling, and PCX-057 Project Catalog remain accurately documented and did not justify cosmetic churn. PCX-056 Mod Health received a material source-backed documentation improvement: the background scan path directly analyzes collected Nexus evidence but does not currently prove that the same evidence is appended into the overlay evidence cache, and the two paths use different logical cache-key shapes. During publication, a temporary one-shot cleanup wrapper blocked two Wiki sync runs; the verified normal wiki publisher was restored at commit 965bfacab779d48c95a71691e13cee712ad61d4d, after which workflow 32158805255 fresh-cloned and byte-verified ProjectDump.wiki.git at master ed45bdb48253f31c45ae1d76cb265e89f278b2db. The updated PCX-056 wiki is also durably mirrored in Drive Project Wikis and independently re-read/exported.
